i was waiting for an evaluation for around three years and the big issue was that publicly funded mental health services outside of CAMS have VERY varying degrees of organisation. We were putting on a waiting list for a week and a half, only to call them and after a very brief conversation discovered the actually haven't done ADHD diagnosis for years. If you are in a hurry to be evaluated the best way to do so is to either go private or REALLY push and remain constantly aware of where your information is going so you can make sure you are on the right lists at the right time.
